name_zh: 圣马丁/阿根廷/解放/安第斯/智利/秘鲁/将军/独立
description_zh: 何塞·德·圣马丁（1778-1850），阿根廷将军、国家英雄，南美洲独立运动的核心领袖。他率领安第斯军团穿越雪山，解放了智利和秘鲁，与玻利瓦尔共同奠定了南美独立的基础。圣马丁的战略眼光、军事才能和对自由的执着追求，使他成为拉丁美洲独立运动中最具国际视野的革命家之一。他主动让位给玻利瓦尔，展现了超越个人权力的政治智慧。
description_en: José de San Martín (1778-1850), Argentine general and national hero, core leader of South American independence movements. He led the Army of the Andes across the mountains to liberate Chile and Peru, jointly laying the foundation for South American independence with Bolívar. San Martín's strategic vision, military prowess, and commitment to freedom made him one of the most internationally minded revolutionaries in Latin American independence. His voluntary yielding to Bolívar demonstrated political wisdom transcending personal power.
reason_zh: 圣马丁代表了拉丁美洲独立运动中军事解放与政治智慧相结合的典范。他穿越安第斯山脉的远征是人类军事史上的壮举，解放智利的阿里卡战役和解放秘鲁的决策展示了他卓越的战略眼光。作为南美独立运动的三大领袖之一，他的跨国家解放战略对拉美政治格局产生了不可逆转的影响。
reason_en: San Martín represents the paradigm of combining military liberation with political wisdom in Latin American independence movements. His crossing of the Andes Mountains was a feat in military history, and his liberation of Chile at the Battle of Chacabuco and the decision to liberate Peru demonstrated exceptional strategic vision. As one of the three great leaders of South American independence, his transnational liberation strategy had an irreversible impact on Latin America's political landscape.
steps_zh: 研究圣马丁早年西班牙军旅生涯与法国革命思想的接触
分析1812年返回阿根廷后策划智利解放的战略布局
探讨1817年安第斯军团穿越雪山的军事壮举与阿里卡战役
评估1821年进入利马宣布秘鲁独立的历史意义与政治影响
总结1822年瓜亚基尔会议让位玻利瓦尔的政治智慧与革命遗产
steps_en: Study San Martín's early Spanish military career and exposure to French revolutionary ideas
Analyze the strategic planning for Chilean liberation after returning to Argentina in 1812
Explore the 1817 crossing of the Andes by the Army of the Andes and the Battle of Chacabuco
Evaluate the historical significance and political impact of entering Lima in 1821 to declare Peruvian independence
Summarize the political wisdom and revolutionary legacy of yielding to Bolívar at the Guayaquil Conference in 1822
expected_zh: 掌握圣马丁作为南美独立运动核心领袖的战略思想，理解安第斯远征的军事奇迹与政治意义，评估其对拉丁美洲独立格局和现代国家形成的深远影响。
expected_en: Master San Martín's strategic thought as the core leader of South American independence, understand the military miracle and political significance of the Andean expedition, and evaluate his profound impact on Latin American independence格局 and modern state formation.
case_zh: 1817年2月，圣马丁率领6000人的安第斯军团穿越海拔4000米的雪山隘口，在极寒和缺氧条件下完成人类军事史上最壮观的行军之一。随后在1817年2月24日的阿里卡战役中击败西班牙军队，解放智利。1821年7月进入利马宣布秘鲁独立，建立保护国制度。1822年7月在瓜亚基尔与玻利瓦尔会晤后主动退隐法国，将南美解放事业交给继任者。
case_en: In February 1817, San Martín led an Army of the Andes of 6,000 soldiers across mountain passes at 4,000 meters altitude, completing one of the most spectacular marches in military history under extreme cold and hypoxia. Subsequently defeating Spanish forces at the Battle of Chacabuco on February 24, 1817, liberating Chile. In July 1821, entering Lima to declare Peruvian independence and establishing a protectorate system. In July 1822, after meeting with Bolívar at Guayaquil, he voluntarily retired to France, entrusting the South American liberation cause to his successors.
cross_cultural_impact: South American independence leader, cross-continental liberation strategist
